name: Lynyrd Skynyrd

whyMatters.en: Jacksonville Southern hard-rock band with a three-guitar lineup. Free Bird and Sweet Home Alabama put dual/triple-lead writing and open-G country riffs on 1970s FM hard rock.
whyMatters.zh: 杰克逊维尔南方硬摇滚乐队，三吉他编制。Free Bird 与 Sweet Home Alabama 把双/三主音写法与 open-G country riff 送上 1970 年代 FM 硬摇滚。

lyricQuotes: If I leave here tomorrow / Would you still remember me
Sweet home Alabama / Where the skies are so blue

shortBio.en: Southern three-guitar hard rock; Free Bird solo stack and Sweet Home Alabama riff as 1970s FM staples.
shortBio.zh: 南方三吉他硬摇滚；Free Bird 叠 solo 与 Sweet Home Alabama riff 是 1970 年代 FM 常备。

body.en:
Lynyrd Skynyrd grew out of Jacksonville high-school bands (My Backyard and others); the name settled mid-1960s after gym teacher Leonard Skinner. Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd (1973) and Second Helping (1974) document the classic attack: Van Zant vocal, Rossington/Collins/(King) triple guitar, Powell piano fills.

Free Bird builds from organ/piano ballad into an extended dual-lead solo section—a concert climax form. Sweet Home Alabama answers Neil Young with an open-G riff and gang vocal. The 1977 plane crash ended the original peak; Street Survivors is the last studio album with Van Zant and Steve Gaines.
body.zh:
Lynyrd Skynyrd 源于杰克逊维尔高中乐队（My Backyard 等）；60 年代中期因体育老师 Leonard Skinner 定名。Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd（1973）与 Second Helping（1974）记录经典攻击：Van Zant 人声、Rossington/Collins/(King) 三吉他、Powell 钢琴填充。

Free Bird 从风琴/钢琴谣曲推到延长双主音 solo——演唱会高潮结构。Sweet Home Alabama 用 open-G riff 与合唱人声回应 Neil Young。1977 空难结束原班高峰；Street Survivors 是 Van Zant 与 Steve Gaines 的最后录音室专辑。

note.en: Ballad into dual-lead climax; piano intro then stacked guitar solos.
note.zh: 谣曲推到双主音高潮；钢琴 intro 后叠吉他 solo。

note.en: Open-G riff and three-guitar weave; Second Helping FM staple.
note.zh: Open-G riff 与三吉他编织；Second Helping FM 常备。

note.zh: 出自 Street Survivors 的警告曲；Gaines 期三吉他密度。

body.en:
Skynyrd stacks Les Paul and SG tones in interlocking rhythm and dual lead—close to Allman Brothers twin-guitar logic, louder and more FM-hook driven.

Free Bird and Sweet Home Alabama are the two main poles: extended solo architecture versus a three-chord regional anthem.

Van Zant writes plainspoken verses; Powell’s piano is a clear Southern hard-rock marker.
body.zh:
Skynyrd 用 Les Paul 与 SG 音色叠节奏与双主音——接近 Allman Brothers 双吉他逻辑，更响、更偏 FM 钩子。

Free Bird 与 Sweet Home Alabama 是两个主要极点：延长 solo 结构，以及三和弦地域颂歌。

Van Zant 写直白话主歌；Powell 钢琴是明确的南方硬摇滚识别点。

title.zh: King 到 Gaines 三吉他高峰

body.en:
Ed King completed the three-guitar Second Helping era; Steve Gaines joined in 1976 for Street Survivors.

Artimus Pyle replaced Bob Burns mid-decade. Core writers: Van Zant with Collins and Rossington.

The 1977 crash killed Van Zant, Steve Gaines, and Cassie Gaines; the original peak lineup ends there.
body.zh:
Ed King 补齐 Second Helping 三吉他；Steve Gaines 于 1976 年加入 Street Survivors。

十年中期 Artimus Pyle 替换 Bob Burns。核心写作：Van Zant 与 Collins、Rossington。

1977 空难夺走 Van Zant、Steve Gaines、Cassie Gaines；原班高峰阵容止于此。

title.en: Southern hard rock on US FM
title.zh: 美国 FM 上的南方硬摇滚

body.en:
Guns N’ Roses and later Southern and hard-rock acts cite the three-guitar weave and Free Bird climax structure.

Sweet Home Alabama remains a widely taught open-G riff; Free Bird is a live-length endurance reference.

Scene place is US FM hard rock crossed with country-rock, more than British metal.
body.zh:
Guns N’ Roses 与后来的南方/硬摇滚乐队引用三吉他编织与 Free Bird 高潮结构。

Sweet Home Alabama 仍是常练的 open-G riff；Free Bird 是现场时长耐力参照。

场景位置在美国 FM 硬摇滚与 country-rock 交叉，多于英国金属。
